items.summary: Approve containment-only execution. No new implementation, proposal, experiment, telemetry, spend, deployment, requeue, dependency, or monetization change is safely queueable this cycle. Existing opportunities remain deferred backlog because active measurement, failed-request repair, ownership, release validation, rollback, deduplication, attribution, and security evidence gates remain open. Continue only existing repair-or-close, measurement, attribution, legal, security, and owner-disposition work.

Technical review: the proposed deferred SEO, UX, accessibility, performance, content, affiliate, and repository work is generally feasible, isolatable, reversible, and measurable in principle, but none has a safe implementation slot now. Do not infer readiness from queue-ready status alone. Before future dispatch, require an isolated worktree, scoped diff, deterministic validation, recorded before-state, existing-telemetry metric, rollback path, ownership, and deduplication check.

Continue existing failure containment and repair-or-close work. Do not requeue failed or cancelled requests until root cause, ownership, isolated validation, rollback, reviewer evidence, and deduplication are recorded. Treat unavailable operations and security sweeps as unknown; they do not prove safety or compromise.

Continue the existing read-only security and legal evidence work. Preserve private launch gates and parked dispositions. No security-sensitive release, public exposure, configuration or credential change, dependency addition, alert expansion, or external outreach is authorized until the existing gates are complete.

Continue period-aligned revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation using recorded telemetry only. Preserve aggregate provider commission as unattributed and keep site revenue, margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, cost-to-learn, and causal lift unknown.

Retain the existing readiness briefs as evidence-only work. Record one owner disposition for each existing brief without duplicating reports, changing production, adding telemetry, spending, or altering launch state. Any future launch requires owner, legal, security, measurement, compliance, affiliate, release, and rollback gates.
